title: 9pm kitchen workout: 4 quiet moves for the last 10 minutes of your day
caption: Night workout at home, right after the kitchen is clean: four quiet moves, about ten minutes. Seated Knee Lift, Wall Sit, Standing Hip Hinge and Shoulder Blade Squeeze, with nothing to buy and nothing loud. Save this for 9pm.

overlays.text: POV: it is 9pm, the kitchen is clean, and you have 10 minutes left.

scenes.footer: Core. The chair you just pushed in.

overlays.text: Seated Knee Lift. 10 reps. Sit tall on a kitchen chair, lift one knee, lower slow.

scenes.footer: Squat. The wall by the fridge.

overlays.text: Wall Sit. 30 seconds. Back flat on the kitchen wall, knees bent, hold.
Standing Hip Hinge. 10 reps. Push your hips back, flat back, stand tall again.

scenes.footer: Pull. Shoulders back from the sink.

overlays.text: Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Arms down, squeeze your shoulder blades together.

scenes.footer: No push tonight. Ten minutes is still complete.

overlays.text: Two rounds of the four, slow, with a minute of rest between. About ten minutes.
What time do your 10 minutes start?
